text:
Nina: FYI renewal for Aurora Systems is coming due 2026-07-10. Procurement uploaded PO but asked if we can switch to quarterly invoicing instead of annual to match their cashflows. Also PO is issued to 'Aurora APAC Pte Ltd' while the contract lists 'Aurora Systems, Inc'. tagging @Omar @Felix
Keiko: Procurement note: APAC finance wants quarterly invoices in SGD, please confirm if Redwood can bill in SGD and accept local PO. They prefer DocuSign but can attach statutory docs if required.
Felix: Quick finance checks: (1) We can bill in SGD but need currency conversion and FX routing set up. (2) Quarterly billing changes our revenue recognition cadence; need to confirm tax/VAT handling per jurisdiction. We'll need vendor docs for the APAC entity (local tax reg) and the remit-to bank details.
Omar: Legal: Entity swap + billing cadence change are material. We can do a narrow amendment that: (a) adds APAC entity as invoicing party, (b) switches invoicing frequency to quarterly, (c) keeps pricing and term unchanged, and (d) contains an explicit clause on tax/responsibility. Need authorized signer for Aurora APAC and a CIS/ISR (company registration) copy.
Nina: Customer preference is minimal paperwork. They asked whether a PO alone (with the signed PO addressed to APAC entity) would suffice without an amendment.
Omar: PO-only is risky here because it changes billing party and payment terms. We should do an amendment and attach the PO as Exhibit A. That keeps obligations clear.
Keiko: Can the amendment include a clause for a 30-day billing window after each quarter close? They want invoices due on net30 from invoice date.
Felix: Net30 is fine. But for quarterly invoices we need clear dates (e.g., Q1 services: Apr-Jun invoice sent July 5). Please avoid backdating. Also require EIN/local tax ID for APAC entity for tax withholding checks.
ESignBot: New envelope created id: env_0xB3 for "Aurora - APAC entity + quarterly billing amendment" sent at 1765012500.
Nina: Drafted language here: https://redwood.internal/drafts/aurora-quarterly-apac-amend.pdf. Key bullets: entity onboarding info, currency = SGD, invoice schedule, preserved annual pricing, attach PO# A-4421 as Exhibit A, effective upon signing. Omar please review.
Omar: Reviewed. Add a clause that VAT/GST or any local taxes are customer responsibility and that currency conversion fees are on customer. Also include a signature confirmation requirement (company reg + authorized signer letter) if signer is not on the current SOW.
Keiko: I've asked Aurora procurement to upload company reg cert and confirm authorized signer. They'll try to get it by EOD APAC (their morning).
Felix: Also request their bank remit details for SGD settlement. Tagging finance@redwood when sent.
Nina: Sending to customer now with a short note: "Please confirm authorized signer and upload company reg cert; we will send DocuSign amendment to the confirmed signer."
ESignBot: Envelope env_0xB3 viewed by procurement@auroraapac.sg at 1765012780.
Keiko: Procurement asked if we can keep the original renewal effective date (2026-07-10) while invoices start quarterly after that date. They want first invoice to cover Jul-Sep.
Omar: That's acceptable: amendment will state "effective upon execution" and specify invoicing schedule starting the first full quarter after the effective date. No revenue backdating.
Felix: Finance confirmed once signed we'll raise first invoice in SGD for Jul-Sep pro-rata if needed; need vendor docs first.
Nina: Customer responded with company reg doc and indicated signer is CFO@auroraapac.sg but will attach officer attestation. Uploading to thread.
Nina: Update: CFO attached officer attestation saying they are authorized. Moving to send DocuSign.
ESignBot: Envelope env_0xB3 signed by CFO@auroraapac.sg at 1765013050.
Nina: Great 389
Action items: Omar to finalize amendment clause on taxes, Felix to intake vendor docs and update ERP, Keiko to confirm PO gets attached as Exhibit A. I'll update renewal status to "signed - awaiting finance intake".
Felix: I'll update vendor and confirm currency routing once docs are in.
Omar: I'll finalize the clean sign-ready amendment now and send to Nina.
Keiko: Noted. Thanks all.
